warning: Real 1 arc-second elevation (Open-Meteo / SRTM) and real ESA WorldCover land cover, but this is still a screening view: sinks are not conditioned, there is no flow routing, and it is not a flood prediction.

assumptions.curveNumberSource: USDA NRCS TR-55; awaiting independent verification
assumptions.doubleCountingRule: Land cover sets the generation term; explicit storage sets the retention term. Open water generates nothing so a pond is never counted in both (ADR-015).

render.note: Depth beyond maxVisibleDepthM is visually saturated, not capped in the data.

landClassProvenance: ESA WorldCover 10 m v200 (2021), CC BY 4.0; see data/landcover_hsk.json
